assets.questionText: Wait, you're my roommate? No way! I'm Marco, an exchange student from Spain. Nice to meet you! So what's your name? Tell me about yourself!
So what do you do for fun? What got you into it?
I'm so into Korea right now — the food, the dramas, everything. If I ever visit, where do you take me first?
Are you a clean person? Like, how often do you actually clean your room?
How do you wanna split the chores? You don't mind doing dishes, do you?
Are you a morning person or a night owl? I stay up way too late, so I'm a little worried, haha.
Hey, we should hang out this weekend! Does Saturday work, or is Sunday better for you?
Is there anything you've been wanting to do since you got here? Maybe we can do it this weekend.
So what do you usually do when you hang out with your friends?
Ah, I see. Let me check your account… yes, I do see the $100 A/C charge for July. Could you tell me a bit more about when you were away?
Got it. We'd just need some proof that you were away — plane tickets, booking confirmations, anything like that. What do you have?
Perfect. Once we confirm it, we'll credit it back — it usually takes about two weeks though. Would that be alright?
Hey, heads up — I was gonna have a couple friends over at our room on Friday. That's cool with you, right?
Oh, and I used your charger yesterday — mine died and it was kind of an emergency. Is it okay if I use your stuff like that sometimes, or would you rather I ask every time?
What do you like the room to be like on weeknights? Music on, totally quiet...?
Hey, I don't think we've met — I'm Chloe. How do you know the host?
By the way, your English is really good! Did you study abroad before?
My friend's having a potluck next week — you should come! Everyone brings something. What would you make?
Do you have any siblings? I'm an only child, so I've always wondered what that's like.
What do you actually want to do with your life? Like, your real dream — not the one you tell professors.
Hey, you've seemed a little down lately. Is everything okay?
Hey, is anyone sitting here? Mind if I sit down? I'm Marco, by the way.
So why'd you take this class? I'm kind of regretting it already, haha.
What's school like in Korea? I've heard it's pretty intense.
So we've got the presentation next week. Which part do you want to take? Honestly, I'm terrified of public speaking.
Have you ever presented in English before? How did it go?
When should we meet up to practice? How's your week looking?
Come on in, have a seat. So, you emailed me about your grade — what's on your mind?
Before I say anything — how did you feel about this essay yourself? Be honest.
Tell you what — I'll reread it tonight and put together some feedback. Do you want to come by tomorrow, or should I just email you?
I can't believe finals are next week. Do you cram everything the night before, or are you one of those people who plans ahead?
I'm so lost on chapter five. Could you help me after class? Are you good at explaining stuff?
We should study together. Where do you usually study, and when are you free?
So today's topic is whether money can buy happiness. What do you think — can it?
Honestly, I feel like people who say money can't buy happiness have just never been broke. Am I wrong?
Okay, say you won a million dollars tomorrow. Do you think you'd actually be happier a year from now?
Hi! I'm in 23B, right next to you. Looks like we're stuck together for the next eleven hours, haha. Where are you headed?
Do you usually go for the window seat or the aisle? I always fight for the window.
What's the best trip you've ever been on?
I'm so sorry about that. Could you show me the damage and tell me what happened?
We can offer a cash refund, mileage points, or a travel voucher — the voucher's worth the most, but it expires in six months. Which would you prefer?
Alright, that's all done. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Hi, welcome! Are you checking in? Can I get your name, please?
I'm so sorry, but your room won't be ready for another hour or so. Would that be alright?
Do you have any preferences for your room? Higher floor, away from the elevator, anything like that.
Hi, sorry to just come up to you like this — I just thought you were really cute. Are you free tonight? Maybe we could grab a coffee?
By the way, are you from around here, or just visiting?
So… could I get your Instagram? I'd love to keep in touch.
Hi, what can I get for you?
For here or to go? And would you like anything else with that?
By the way, our chocolate cookies just came out of the oven. Wanna add one?
Hi, what can I help you with? You don't look so great — what's going on?
When did it start? Do you have a fever, or is it more of an achy, tired feeling?
Take two of these after meals, no more than six a day. Are you allergic to anything?
Is this your first time in London? How are you finding it?
If you haven't eaten yet, I can recommend some great places around here — what are you in the mood for?
So where are you visiting from? What's it like there?
I just got back from Portugal and it was unreal. What about you — what's the best place you've ever been?
Tell me about a trip that went wrong — anything counts, even a school trip. Those stories are the best.
If money wasn't an issue, where would you go next?
No worries, it happens all the time. I can give you a temporary key, or someone can walk up and let you in. Which works better for you?
For the replacement, we can have it ready tomorrow morning, or the day after in the afternoon. When would you like to pick it up?
And we'll let you know when it's ready — would you rather get a text or an email?
So, the fridge has been getting out of hand lately. I was thinking — we could put names on our own stuff, and a green sticker on anything that's up for grabs. What do you think?
And for stuff with no name on it — how about we post a photo in the group chat and give it 24 hours before tossing it? Is that fair?
We should probably clean the fridge out regularly too. Would Friday or Sunday work better for you?
Hey, sorry — I think our laundry got mixed up. I've got your white T-shirt, and I think my blue shirt's in your pile. Could you take a look for me?
Oh, are you done with your drying? If not, wanna throw our stuff in together? It's cheaper that way. Totally fine if you'd rather do yours separately, though!
And if our stuff gets mixed up again, should we just leave it by each other's door, or text and meet up?
Okay, please don't use the sink for now. Do you need anything while you wait — towels, a bucket? I can also walk you through shutting off the water.
We can send someone at six this evening or nine tomorrow morning. Which time works for you?
Should the technician call you first, or just knock? And if you're not in, is it okay for them to go in?
Before the inspection, you'll need to clear out your things and give the room a good clean. Would you like a checklist, or should we do a quick walk-through together first?
We have slots today at three or tomorrow at ten. Which one should I book you in for?

One more thing — if anything's damaged, like the furniture or the walls, it may come out of your deposit. You knew that, right? If there's any damage that wasn't your fault, have some proof ready — photos from move-in, anything like that.
So the direct train gets you there at four and it's $45. The one with a transfer arrives at five, but it's only $30. Which one would you like?
Would you like the ticket printed, or sent to your phone?
And any seat preference — window, aisle?
Honestly, everything here is good. The pasta's mild and creamy, and the curry's got a real kick to it. What are you in the mood for?
Just so you know, we can do the pasta without cheese, or the curry without fish sauce. Want it as is, or should we adjust anything?
Oh, and we're doing a little event — leave us a Google review and you get a free side. Wanna do it? Salad or rice?
Sure! The museum pass gets you into two museums, and the city pass includes public transit too. Which sounds more like your day?
They're both $30, and for $15 more you can add the lunch set. Would you like to include it?
And would you like a paper pass, or the digital one on your phone?
Of course, let's find you another time. The morning tour is a smaller group, and the evening one includes the city lights. Which would you prefer?
Just so you know, the evening tour is $10 more than your original booking. Is that okay with you?
By the way, we also run a food tour and a night river cruise — people love them. Want to try one while you're here? I can get you a discount.
For an extra $50, I can move you up to extra-legroom economy — you can actually stretch your legs. Would you like to do that?
There's also an exit-row seat available for free, but you'd need to help the crew in an emergency. Would you be comfortable with that?
Boarding starts in about twenty minutes. Overhead space is tight today, so we're checking carry-ons for free — do you want to check yours?
So, one course runs on weekly projects, and the other comes down to two big exams. Which style suits you better?
And why that one? I'd like to hear your thinking.
That course has two sections — Tuesday mornings or Thursday afternoons. Which fits your schedule better?
Hey, I heard you were out sick today — you okay? I took notes on the example problems and the assignment changes. What do you want to see first?
I can snap photos and send them now, or just lend you my whole notebook later. What helps more?
Hey, I'm basically saving your life here — you're buying me dinner later, right? Something fancy, obviously. Deal?
So for this assignment, you've got two options — a three-page report, or a five-minute presentation. Which way are you leaning?
What made you go with that one?
And this time, the deadline is the deadline. Remember last time you were one minute late and I let it slide? Not this time — I'll take points off. Okay?
Ah, we're actually out of fresh basil today, sorry! What are you cooking? I can help you find a good substitute.

The big pack is cheaper, but it's a lot — if you live alone, some might go to waste. The small one costs a bit more, but you'll finish it before it expires. It doesn't keep long, so — which one would you go with?
Oh, and tomatoes are 20% off if you buy them together. Want to grab some?
So we've got this casual jacket, or a dressier blazer. What's the vibe for the event — pretty relaxed, or a bit more formal?
Both come in navy and beige. Which color do you want to try on first?
One thing to know — the jacket's final sale, but the blazer you can return within three days. Which one are you going with?
For a friend? Okay — the snack set is $15 and easy to share, or there's this handmade mug for $25, something they'd keep. Which feels more like your friend?
We can pop in a message card for free. What would you like it to say?
And wrapping — standard is free, or gift wrapping is $3 extra. How should I wrap it?
So Model A is $120 with stronger noise canceling, and Model B is $80 and a lot lighter. Which one sounds more like what you need?
What matters most to you in headphones — the sound, the weight, or the price?
It comes in black, white, and gray. Which color should I grab for you?
Here it is! Feel free to take it for a spin, or look it over first — there are a couple of scratches I'll show you. What do you want to do first?
I'm asking $200, but I'm open to offers if you've got a fair reason. What were you thinking?
Alright — you can pay the full amount in cash today, right? Then we've got a deal.
Oh no, sorry about that. Do you mind if we test it real quick to see if it cuts out? It won't affect your return either way.
Either way, here are your options — I can swap it for a new one today, or do a refund, which takes up to five days. Which would you prefer?
Again, I'm so sorry about the trouble. Here — we'd like to give you a box of tea as an apology. I hope that makes up for it a little!
Sure! How long are you staying here, and do you use a lot of data?
So the prepaid plan is $30 for ten gigs, and unlimited is $45 a month. Which one fits you better?
I'll need your passport to register the SIM. And should I set up auto-pay, or will you top it up yourself each month?
